scope: One optional feature-specific fuel attempt after prescribed queues. Original six finalists remain unchanged. No validation result may enter the choice.
parent_rule: Among original K005 grid 2/3 lines with positive BP gain and R1 failure exclusively on fuel, choose most wins then fewer total fuel-outs.
floor_rule: Re-pair original grid 4 to BP; require R1 pass, gain >=0, real-map fuel <206. Choose lowest ladder+styled fuel; ties higher wins, lower total fuel, label.
merge_rule: Apply only the chosen BUSHPRE/BUSHPRE_LAZY/SIEGEFUEL values to the parent, preserving its plan/anti-feed flags. Run one full x2/x2-s2 gate vs BP.
validation_rule: Only if positive gain and R1 pass, evaluate the fixed retry against v86h/v86h-s2/v81hl on standard and the same frozen fresh maps. No further tuning based on those scores. This is a supplementary candidate outside the original top six.
skip_rule: If no qualifying parent/floor exists, skip the attempt.
implementation_update_note: Added joint never-switch control after measured negative training interaction; optional fuel-retry selection and validation rule unchanged. Still before all K006/fresh-map outcomes.
